(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bg 0)
             (define dots
               (sort-by (filter (lambda (rc) (!= (at g (first rc) (second rc)) bg))
                                (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                           (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                         (range 0 h)))
                        (lambda (rc) (first rc))))
             (define center (second dots))
             (define cr (first center))
             (define cc (second center))
             (define color (at g cr cc))
             (define d1 (first dots))
             (define step
               (max (abs (- (first center) (first d1)))
                    (abs (- (second center) (second d1)))))
             (define (in-b r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w)))
             (define (square-outline s)
               (let* ((tr (- cr s))
                      (br (+ cr s))
                      (lc (- cc s))
                      (rc (+ cc s)))
                 (append (map (lambda (c) (list tr c)) (range lc (+ rc 1)))
                         (map (lambda (c) (list br c)) (range lc (+ rc 1)))
                         (map (lambda (r) (list r lc)) (range tr (+ br 1)))
                         (map (lambda (r) (list r rc)) (range tr (+ br 1))))))
             (define max-s (+ (max h w) 1))
             (define max-k (quotient max-s step))
             (define all-cells
               (flatmap (lambda (k) (square-outline (* k step))) (range 0 (+ max-k 2))))
             (define valid-cells
               (filter (lambda (rc) (in-b (first rc) (second rc))) all-cells))
             (recolor-cells g valid-cells color)))))
